quarterly_data.quarter: Lattice Semiconductor press release: Lattice Delivers Industry-First PQC-Enabled Platform (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lattice announced the Lattice Sentry solution stack v5.0, which it calls the industry's first post-quantum cryptography (PQC)-enabled Platform Firmware Resilience (PFR) and attestation solution. It combines Lattice's CNSA 2.0-compliant FPGA portfolio with AMI's platform management software (AMI Tektagon PQC Resiliency) to give CNSA 2.0-aligned, NIST-compliant protection across AI data centers and critical infrastructure: NIST SP800-193-compliant BIOS, BMC and board firmware protection, detection and autonomous recovery; ML-DSA, LMS and XMSS authentication and ML-KEM key exchange; and SPDM-based device attestation across servers and rack infrastructure. Demo boards and custom design services are available now. Mamta Gupta (VP, Business Development, Compute & Communications): 'Lattice Sentry delivers both, strengthening our leadership in secure, deterministic control for AI infrastructure.'
quarterly_data.figure: Lattice Sentry v5.0; CNSA 2.0; NIST SP800-193; demo boards and custom design services available now
